## Shiny Documents

This quarto document represents the full workflow to add ftmsneg flax to
Dynlib sql database, and then to a CompDb and spectra Objects. The
retention times in Dynlib are in minutes, but in flax data are in
seconds. In the following workflow while adding flax to Dynlib we will
unify the units and convert the retention times of flax data to minutes.

Note: In this file we will need the similarity output file between the
existing database and the new experiment that we would like to  add,
that's why we have to run first this quarto document: \
[FTMS_neg_call.qmd](https://github.com/rebdau/RDynLib_SQL/blob/Ahlam/vignettes/FTMS_neg_call.qmd)
and load the output here.

# Directroy layout

This project follows an  R package layout as follows:

The main project folder is:

RDynLib_SQL/


Within this directory, the structure is organized as follows:

RDynLib_SQL/
├── data/
├── R/
└── vignettes/


### `data/`

Contains the SQLite database files used in the workflow (e.g., `ftms_flax_neg.sqlite`).

### `R/`

Contains the R source files (`.R`) that define the package functions and core implementation.

### `vignettes/`

Contains Quarto (`.qmd`) files that document the workflow and provide reproducible examples.

In this workflow, the working directory is set to the project root:

RDynLib_SQL/

# Required packages

```{r}
library(here)
library(Spectra)
library(DBI)
library(dplyr)
library(RSQLite)
library(CompoundDb)
library(devtools)

#` Uploading RDynLibSQL: Load all functions of the RDynlib directory
load_all()

register(SerialParam())

```

#Import data from zenodo

Loading the sql database of flax ftms negative from zenodo and create an sql
connection to the database:
```{r}
# flaxseed_FTneg
get_dynlib_zenodo(
  doi = ,
  file = "flax_ftms.sqlite",
  destdir = "data"
)
flax_ftneg <- here("data", "flax_ftneg.sqlite")
con_fft <- dbConnect(RSQLite::SQLite(), flax_ftneg)
```

Loading the sql database of maize ftms negative from zenodo and create an sql
connection to the database:
```{r}
# maize_FTneg
get_dynlib_zenodo(
  doi = ,
  file = "maize_ftmsneg.sqlite",
  destdir = "data"
)
maize_ftneg <- here("data", "maize_ftneg.sqlite")
con_mftneg <- dbConnect(RSQLite::SQLite(), maize_ftneg)
```

Here we show the available tables in both databases:
flax ftms negative:

```{r}
dbListTables(con_fft)
```

Maize ftms negative:
```{r}
dbListTables(con_mftneg)
```

# Merge databases
```{r}
# Create new database
dbf <- here("data", "MAIZE_FLAX_FTMSneg.sqlite")


# merge
merge_databases(
  main_db   = maize_ftneg,
  add_db    = flax_ftneg,
  output_db = dbf
)
#create the connection to the sql database
con_merged <- dbConnect(RSQLite::SQLite(), dbf)

```

# Check merging
```{r}
dbListTables(con_merged)
```

```{r}
dbGetQuery(con_merged, "PRAGMA table_info(msms_spectrum);")
dbGetQuery(con_merged, "PRAGMA table_info(ms_compound);")
```

### Ensuring the experiment table has been well merged

```{r}
dbReadTable(con_merged, "experiment")
```

```{r}
dbGetQuery(con_merged, "Select * from experiment where user = 'ament'")
```

The new experiment has 266 as expid

### Ensuring the ms_compound has been well merged

```{r}
dbGetQuery(con_mftneg, "
  SELECT * FROM ms_compound
  ORDER BY CAST(compound_id AS INTEGER) DESC
  LIMIT 10
")

```

The highest compound_id is 100911 in the Dynlib database

```{r}
dbGetQuery(con_merged, "Select * from ms_compound where expid = 266 LIMIT 10")
```

#Ensuring the msms_spectrum table has been well merged

```{r}
dbGetQuery(con_mftneg, "
  SELECT * FROM msms_spectrum
  ORDER BY CAST(spectrum_id AS INTEGER) DESC
  LIMIT 10
")
```


```{r}
dbGetQuery(con_merged, "Select * from msms_spectrum where compound_id = 100912 Limit 10")
```


Ensuring the msms_spectrum_peak table has been well merged

```{r}
dbGetQuery(con_merged, "Select * from msms_spectrum_peak where spectrum_id = 201035")
```

Ensuring the feature_matrix table has been well merged

```{r}
dbReadTable(con_merged, "feature_matrix")
```

```{r}
dbGetQuery(con_merged, "Select * from feature_matrix where expid = 266 LIMIT 10")
```

# Converting the merged sql connection to a compdb object

```{r}
cdb <- CompDb(con_merged)
cdb
```

```{r}
compounds(cdb) |> head()
```

```{r}
sp <- Spectra(cdb)
```

```{r}
spectraData(sp, columns = c("msLevel", "compound_id", "nodename", "rtime", "retention_time", "spectrum_type"))
```

# Disonnect databases
```{r}
dbDisconnect(con_flax)
dbDisconnect(con_mftneg)
dbDisconnect(con_merged)
```
